test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 1 i.e. even though.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Even** **though** is the most appropriate option to fill the blank.
 
• **Even** **though** means ‘despite the fact that’. It shows contract.
 
• It is more emphatic than although and though.
 
• Hence the correct answer is **option 1.**

Correct Paragraph:__ *Connie Sellecca plays first officer Mimi Thompkins who manages successfully to land Flight 243 after its roof is ripped (1) __off__ mid-flight due to mental fatigue. She is not the only one (2) __on__ that flight, since there was also a flight attendant who kept checking on people. And telling them they were going to be fine ****(3) __even though__*** *they had giant pieces of aeroplane carpet stuck to their heads. I can’t (4)_________ land a plane or tell the wounded people that they would be fine soon, due to the fact that I would be (5)_________ too hard and throwing out what ever food I had throughout the day. *
